story_text:
## Meet CalmNook BD Hub
## Don't let new ports lock away your memories.
Remember that old shoebox under your bed? It isn't shoes — it's a pile of faded photos, a few tape cassettes, and the DVD you burned of your family's first big trip.
Cloud storage can save your files, but it can't save that urge to open them again. And every new laptop drops another port — so replaying those discs means digging out a stack of adapters. A memory shouldn't have to fight your hardware to be seen.
That's exactly what the CalmNook BluHub is built for — one clean device that brings your whole collection and daily workflow together, no extra gadgets and no tangle of cables required.
## 10-in-1 Multi-Port Blu-ray Hub
The CalmNook BluHub is a 10‑in‑1 multiport Blu‑ray hub that folds a disc drive, a card reader and a fast USB hub into one slim body — the single device that ties your old discs and daily workflow together, whether you're reviving a dusty CD collection, backing up years of family videos, or just clearing off a cluttered desk.
It covers every port you actually need: four USB‑A ports, all running at 10Gbps, so 4K footage, Blu‑ray images and big projects transfer in minutes; dual card slots (SD + TF) that read together for one‑go camera imports; USB power plus DC‑C auxiliary power to keep heavy burns steady; and a built‑in Y‑cable, with a bonus USB‑A to USB‑C cable for new and old ports. Small enough to fit in one hand and slip into a bag, it travels as easily as it sits on your desk.
And it's more than a DVD/CD drive — it reads and burns Blu‑ray discs that hold 25GB, 50GB or up to 100GB each, enough for 4K videos and large projects an ordinary optical drive can't fit. Best of all, using it is genuinely simple: plug it in, your computer recognizes it instantly, and whether you're a first‑time user or a pro editor, you're up and running in seconds.
## Blu‑ray Read & Write — Archiving and Transfer in One
At its heart, the CalmNook BD Hub lets you store your precious files in a format built to outlast time. Blu‑ray works as offline cold storage: no network dependency, no recurring subscriptions, and no risk of a hard drive silently failing. Burn your files once, tuck the disc away safely, and your photos and videos will stay exactly as you saved them — locked away, untouched.
It also breathes new life into your old disc collection. Classic CDs, DVDs and Blu‑rays are all readable anytime you want to revisit them. You can rip aging CDs into permanent digital copies. Physical discs will wear down and scratch over time, but your digitized versions won’t.
Your files don’t need to be trapped on the media they were originally saved on. Move data freely between discs, memory cards and USB drives. Archive footage straight from your camera cards onto Blu‑ray, or pull vintage photos off old discs to share. Your data goes wherever you want it to.
## Plug & Go, Speed Ahead
Nothing kills a setup faster than hunting for drivers. CalmNook BD Hub is recognized the moment you plug it in — no downloads, no installs, no restarts. It's ready to go before you've even finished plugging in the rest.
And "ready to go" doesn't mean slow. With 10Gbps bandwidth, 4K footage, Blu‑ray images and big project files move in minutes, not hours — so you spend less time watching progress bars and more time actually creating.
## All Ports, Dual‑Card Reading
CalmNook brings every port you need into one place: four high‑speed USB‑A ports at 10Gbps, and a built‑in Blu‑ray/DVD/CD drive. A camera, a USB drive or any other peripheral always finds a port ready for it — plug in your card reader, hook up your drives, and connect everything at once.
SD and TF slots read together, so you import everything from your camera in one go. Photographers, drone pilots and creators — give the time you spent swapping cards back to editing.
## Stable Power ,Built‑In Cable
Power dips can make a long burn fail halfway, or a worn disc stutter and stop reading. CalmNook BD Hub adds DC‑C auxiliary power on top of standard USB bus power, keeping demanding reads and large burns stable. Whether you're archiving big files in bulk or reading aged, scratched discs, it keeps going reliably without cutting out under voltage fluctuation.
And when the job's done, there's one less thing to lose. The Y‑cable is built directly into the body — fixed and always attached, with a bonus USB‑A to USB‑C cable included for newer or older ports. Set it on your desk or bring it to the studio, plug in and start working.
## Quiet & Stable Operation
The hum of an optical drive shouldn't interrupt your focus.
CalmNook BD Hub sits stable on its non‑slip base — plugging in, pressing, opening the tray, it stays put. A low‑vibration mechanism keeps reading and writing quiet, so it holds steady on your desk and lets you focus on the task at hand.
## Pocket‑Sized, Desk‑Worthy
You chose a slim laptop to carry less. CalmNook BD Hub thinks the same way — a compact, light body that stays neat on your desk and slips into a bag, with the cable built in so there's one less thing to bring. Lightness shouldn't be reserved for your computer.
## Wide System Compatibility
CalmNook BD Hub works with Windows and macOS, so whether you're working, creating or managing files, it connects without a hitch. It also supports Android OTG devices, including Android tablets and phones, for reading discs, transferring photos and managing data across devices. iOS users can access files on USB and SD cards as well. It fits more scenarios with virtually no device limits.
## Why Choose CalmNook

Each milestone adds a practical piece to your archiving kit: hit $30,000 and everyone gets 1 marker pen to start labeling their collection; pass $50,000 and we add 2 blank DVD‑R discs; reach $80,000 and you'll get a CD storage case to keep up to a dozen discs tidy. ## About the Team
We are a team of engineers, designers and product specialists focused on computer peripheral hardware. Our core members have brought multiple Kickstarter hardware projects to life, covering prototype validation, mass production oversight and global order fulfillment. We are committed to getting every unit to backers reliably and on schedule.
Our 10‑in‑1 multi‑function DVD docking station was born from genuine user pain points. Most modern laptops no longer include built‑in optical drives, forcing users to carry separate external DVD burners, USB hubs and card readers. Alternatives on the market tend to be bulky, noisy, or plagued by unstable USB bus power. To solve these headaches, we integrated all these features into one compact all‑in‑one device.
We ran extensive real‑world tests on disc reading stability, port compatibility, shock resistance, and plug‑and‑play performance across both Windows and macOS. Every prototype endured long‑duration disc burning tests to confirm consistent reliability. Backed by mature production lines and trusted supply chain partners, we are fully prepared to scale this design from prototype to mass delivery.
Our mission is straightforward: streamline your desktop and on‑the‑go workflow with practical, consolidated computer peripherals.
## Time Line
risks: We have successfully completed full production and delivery of our previous computer‑peripheral projects with outstanding user feedback and stable after‑sales performance. With rich manufacturing experience for external optical drives and docking hardware, our team is well‑prepared for delivery. Still, potential risks may occur: • Supply Chain Delays: Raw‑material shortages or global logistics fluctuations could shift production timelines. We keep production buffers and will publish regular campaign updates to keep all backers informed. • Mass‑production consistency: Transitioning prototypes to mass‑volume manufacturing may bring unexpected assembly issues. Our internal QC team will run full‑function sampling tests to guarantee uniform product quality. • Compatibility variance: Different computer hardware combinations may create minor compatibility differences. Our user manual will clearly note desktop rear‑USB‑port power‑supply suggestion for stable performance. We promise active and transparent communication throughout the whole campaign. Thank you sincerely for supporting our 8‑in‑1 Multi‑function DVD Docking Station project.

faq.q: Does CalmNook BD Hub support Blu‑ray?
faq.a: Yes. It supports Blu‑ray read & write, including BD‑R, BD‑RE and BD‑XL (up to 100GB) — and it also handles DVD and CD.

faq.q: How do I burn files to a disc?
faq.a: Insert a blank disc, open your burning software, select the files, and click Burn. Done.
Yes. Use CD‑ripping software to extract tracks and save them as digital files on your computer, USB drive or memory card.

faq.a: You can use any debit or credit card associated with Visa, Mastercard or American Express, as well as Discover and JCB cards. Kickstarter does not accept payments with PayPal.
In order to pledge, click that green button that says “Back this project”. You'll get to select your shipping country and choose your desired pledge level and reward.

faq.a: Two weeks after the project ends, we will send a survey via email to collect your shipping addresses. Rewards are scheduled to ship in Feb. 2027 via air freight, ensuring delivery within approximately one week.
